defs.def: to make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation 应付，处理，解决（难题或局面）

ex.t: 共同面对困难治愈一切

ex.s: B It can be applied to tackle challenges.
ex.t: B 它可以被用于应对挑战。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术,以帮助公共交通走向绿色,同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: So, I am here on Macquarie Island to participate in the programme to tackle this very problem.
ex.t: 所以,我在这里的麦克夸里岛 参与这个计划 来解决这个问题。

ex.s: The figures disturb the school authorities, who have decided to tackle this problem head-on.
ex.t: 这些数字扰乱了学校当局,他们决定直接解决这一问题。

ex.s: Dr Carol Dweck, a psychology professor at Stanford University, has discovered that people with a fixed mindset tackle problems in a much different way from those with a growth mindset.
ex.t: 斯坦福大学的心理学教授卡罗尔·德韦克博士(Carol Dweck)发现,有固定心态的人解决问题的方式与有增长心态的人大不相同.

defs.def: to speak to sb about a problem or difficult situation 与某人交涉；向某人提起（问题或困难情况）

ex.s: You can’t expect your child to tackle their tasks with enthusiasm while you’re complaining about loading the dishwasher.
ex.t: 你不能一边抱怨着把碗碟放进洗碗机，一边指望孩子满怀热情地完成自己的任务。

ex.s: PASS involves weekly sessions where you work in groups to tackle specially prepared problem sets, based around a unit of study you’re enrolled in.
ex.t: PASS包含每周的小组活动，你以小组形式攻克特别准备的问题集，围绕你所修的一个学习单元。

defs.def: to try and take the ball from an opponent 足球、曲棍球等

ex.s: To tackle this crisis, he chose to study agriculture and received an education at Southwest Agricultural College in Chongqing.
ex.t: 为了应对这场危机，他选择学习农业，并在重庆的西南农业学院接受教育。

defs.def: to make an opponent fall to the ground in order to stop them running 橄榄球或美式足球
to deal with sb who is violent or threatening you 抓获；擒获；给以颜色
an act of trying to take the ball from an opponent in football (soccer), etc; an act of knocking an opponent to the ground in rugby or American football （足球等）抢断球，阻截铲球；（橄榄球或美式足球）擒抱摔倒，阻截
a player whose job is to stop opponents by knocking them to the ground 美式足球
the equipment used to do a particular sport or activity, especially fishing 用具；体育器材；（尤指）渔具
a man's sexual organs 鸡巴；阳具
